presentation.label: BEAT SLICER
presentation.summary: Development draft: create exact beat-spaced slices using sample or project BPM.
presentation.overview: Independent controller and proposed shared AED service for file-backed Flex and Static samples. Private native/browser builds and normal-boot USB/menu/confirmation emulator checks pass; exact hardware and full lifecycle qualification remain pending.
highlights: Choose sample BPM or project BPM.
Stock confirmation and clearing; ordinary stock playback.
usage: Not installable yet. See README.md for the proposed editor workflow and integration blockers.

controls.name: BPM SOURCE
controls.doc: Proposed dialog: use the sample ATTR BPM or the project BPM captured at preview. No silent fallback.

controls.name: SPACING
controls.doc: Proposed dialog: beat spacing, anchored at trim start. A beat is a quarter note.

limitations: Unlisted staging draft; not a released module or base capability.
Requires the proposed shared sample-editor service, enabled only in a private source-built base.
First basic candidate requires stopped playback/recording and file-backed Flex/Static slots 0–127; recorder buffers are excluded.
Exact metadata grid only: no PCM analysis, smoothing or click-free playback claim.
Complete native-menu/USB lifecycle, companion placement, physical timing, audio and persistence remain unqualified.

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: Private fixture sizes are recorded in TESTING.md; installed module/base allocation and the complete stack budget remain unqualified.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: Private instruction and emulated-time measurements are recorded in TESTING.md; installed CPU/DSP cost, physical timing and audible headroom remain unmeasured.

tests.summary: The private base and 0.1.55 controller load on the owner's MKII, open the AED options and pass a 12-module self-test. Its long-file conflict/busy report remains a hardware regression to recheck. The 0.1.56 controller omits stock-invalid new tail boundaries and queues confirmation until a fresh source is ready; host and target-package regressions pass; native menu and exact long-file hardware retests remain pending. Recording buffers, physical marker results, audio and persistence remain unqualified.
gates: verify.py deliberately refuses qualification until native/UI/USB/audio/persistence integration is verified

license.declaration: Original planning core and synthetic tests. No Elektron firmware, extracted routines, tables, samples or dumps included.

access.location: Private candidate: AED → AMP (SLICE) → YES → BEAT SLICER
steps: Select a file-backed Flex or Static sample in a disposable project; stop playback and recording.
With the exact private base and package installed, open AED, press AMP (SLICE), then YES and select BEAT SLICER. This workflow remains under qualification.
Encoder A chooses SAMPLE/PROJECT BPM; encoder B or UP/DOWN chooses spacing. YES requests stock confirmation; NO goes back. Clear slices through the stock slice menu.
